title: Six historical targets with accepted legacy answer routes are falsely classified as fully IN_SCOPE for 2026
evidence: 697372-2026-syllabus.pdf#pdf=19;print=19;section=4.1 lists performance factors and USB/HDMI/VGA ports; it does not list RAM capacity as a performance factor or DisplayPort as a port objective
697372-2026-syllabus.pdf#pdf=23;print=23;section=5.1 lists five OS management tasks and excludes error checking/recovery
697372-2026-syllabus.pdf#pdf=23;print=23;section=5.2 limits IDE presentation examples to prettyprint and expand/collapse
697372-2026-syllabus.pdf#pdf=24;print=24;section=6.2 lists range/format/length/presence/existence/limit/check digit and excludes type check
A_Level_CS_page/planning/paper1/stage-1/evidence/a2/B23/transcripts/9618_s23_ms_11-p05.txt#Q3(b) accepts Error checking and recovery
A_Level_CS_page/planning/paper1/stage-1/evidence/a2/B23/transcripts/9618_s23_ms_12-p04.txt#Q2(c)(i) accepts Type check and Length check; the map omits length and does not quarantine type
A_Level_CS_page/planning/paper1/stage-1/evidence/a2/B23/transcripts/9618_s23_ms_12-p07.txt#Q5(b) accepts increased RAM capacity and Q5(c)(ii) accepts DisplayPort
A_Level_CS_page/planning/paper1/stage-1/evidence/a2/B23/transcripts/9618_s23_ms_13-p07.txt#Q4(d)(i) accepts Type check
A_Level_CS_page/planning/paper1/stage-1/evidence/a2/B23/transcripts/9618_w23_ms_11-p08.txt#Q6(c)(i) accepts Auto indentation/formatting
required_action: Reclassify these units as PARTIAL (or supply an independently reviewed, source-backed alternative status), record the legacy answer route as outside the 2026 boundary, and rebuild primary/supporting requirements. Specifically include REQ-6.2-02-03 for S23/12 Q2(c)(i), remove REQ-4.1-06-03 and retain the in-scope HDMI route for S23/12 Q5(c)(ii), and preserve official alternatives without presenting legacy content as 2026 scope.
acceptance: Each corrected row states the in-scope and legacy boundaries against the exact QP/MS and 2026 syllabus locator; no accepted legacy route remains hidden under IN_SCOPE/HIGH.

title: Two rows claim direct 2026 coverage although their assessed response demand exceeds the cited requirement
evidence: A_Level_CS_page/planning/paper1/stage-1/evidence/a2/B23/transcripts/9618_s23_qp_11-p10.txt#Q4(b) and 9618_s23_ms_11-p07.txt#Q4(b) assess cost, longevity and capacity reasons for choosing magnetic over solid-state storage

697372-2026-syllabus.pdf#pdf=17;print=17;section=3.1 requires principal operations of magnetic hard disk and solid-state memory; REQ-3.1-03-04/-05 encode operations, not comparative cost/longevity/capacity
A_Level_CS_page/planning/paper1/stage-1/evidence/a2/B23/transcripts/9618_w23_qp_11-p11.txt#Q6(b) and 9618_w23_ms_11-p08.txt#Q6(b) require a reason for partial compilation/interpretation

697372-2026-syllabus.pdf#pdf=23;print=23;section=5.2 and REQ-5.2-03-01 require awareness that programs may be partially compiled/interpreted, not portability, runtime optimisation or recompilation reasons
required_action: Do not retain HIGH/IN_SCOPE with the current primary requirements. Reclassify each as SUPPORTING/PARTIAL/NEEDS_REVIEW using a source-backed rationale, and do not credit the cited requirements as directly assessed unless the prompt/MS demand is aligned to them.
acceptance: The corrected records distinguish adjacent historical knowledge from directly assessed 2026 requirements and no operations/awareness objective receives unsupported official coverage.

title: Five requirement sets omit required trace or claim unsupported alternatives
evidence: S23/11 Q4(a)(ii) and W23/11 Q7(c) ask advantages/reasons for using DRAM rather than SRAM; 2026 syllabus p17 and REQ-3.1-06-02 explicitly cover reasons for using SRAM/DRAM, but both rows map only REQ-3.1-06-01
S23/12 MS p08 Q5(d)(ii) gives a generic purpose of utility software; it does not assess all six named utility requirements currently assigned
W23/12 MS p09 Q8(b) lists defragmentation, disk analysis/repair, compression and formatting; the map additionally claims REQ-5.1-03-06 backup without an official answer route
W23/12 MS p10 Q8(c)(i) accepts USB or HDMI; the map additionally claims REQ-4.1-06-03 VGA
required_action: Add REQ-3.1-06-02 to both DRAM-use rows. Remove or explicitly downgrade requirement claims that have no official prompt/MS route: the six-way utility blanket claim, backup for W23/12 Q8(b), and VGA for W23/12 Q8(c)(i). Rebuild affected pattern requirement references consistently.
acceptance: Every primary/supporting requirement is evidenced by the exact prompt and official row; open or generic prompts do not become blanket coverage for named child requirements.

title: Sixty-three nested atomic rows omit their immediate context-only parent part from context_dependency_ids
evidence: Accepted B23 QUESTION_INDEX.jsonl supplies parent_part_id_or_null for each listed atomic row
B23 CONTAINER_MAP.jsonl and UNRESOLVED_DISPOSITION.jsonl correctly retain these parent parts as context-only containers linked to their children
ATOMIC_ITEM_MAP.jsonl lists only the question root in context_dependency_ids for the 63 rows, while six later recovered nested rows correctly list both question root and immediate parent part
required_action: Add the immediate parent_part_id_or_null to context_dependency_ids for every affected nested atomic row, preserve the question-root dependency where needed, and rebuild pattern rows that copy dependency evidence.
acceptance: For every atomic record with a non-null parent_part_id_or_null, the immediate parent is either present in context_dependency_ids or an exact source-backed rationale explains why it is unnecessary; machine check reports zero unexplained omissions.

title: Fourteen source-recovered command words have false Stage 1 provenance
evidence: Accepted B23 QUESTION_INDEX.jsonl has command_word_verbatim_or_null=null for all 14 IDs
B23 ATOMIC_ITEM_MAP.jsonl supplies correct-looking source-observed commands but labels command_word_source=ACCEPTED_STAGE1_EXTRACTION for every row
Stage 2 schema requires source observations to remain separate from analyst-derived classification, and the work order explicitly requires direct source inspection when Stage 1 command is null
required_action: Retain only commands verified against the exact QP page and change provenance to a truthful direct-source value with the QP locator/ref; do not represent a recovered observation as accepted Stage 1 extraction.
acceptance: All 14 commands have direct QP evidence and truthful provenance; zero command_word_source values contradict the accepted Stage 1 record.
